*For what it has to offer, this game is amazing. Being able to accept foreign content is a huge plus! The game itself is amazing! Never before have I experienced anything like ARMA 3. I highly recommend this game to anyone interested in REALISTIC combat and not that C#ck Of Duty Sh#t. For Christ’s sake, there are Hundreds of MODS out there that transform ARMA into a whole new Game! 
*There is the Epoch Mod! – Apocalyptic simulator.
*There is the Breaking Point Mod! (My personal Favorite) It pretty much Kicks DayZ’s ass. It is everything DayZ wanted to be, but couldn’t. I have never in my life actually got an adrenaline rush from a video game such as the one I get from this one. When you hear the crack of a bullet whiz over your head, you know you are probably gonna die. And the players on Breaking Point are ruthless to say the least! You can think that you are best buddies with another player, then they will turn on you in a heart beat. I mean really… You can even pretend to be a zombie! It is insane!
*There is also some sort of Dinosaur Mod out there! 
*This game has so much potential that it makes me wonder why not everyone has adopted it yet. 
*GET A PART TIME JOB, BUY ARMA 3! THEN QUIT THE JOB, AND PLAY ARMA 3! IT IS THAT EASY!!!

*VERY GREAT GAME!
